title: 컴퓨터 매개 학습환경에서 협동적 역할놀이 학습전략이 비구조화된 문제해결에 미치는 효과

abstracts.value: This study investigates the effects of collaborative role-playing on ill-structured problem-solving and also examines the attitudes of college students in a computer-mediated learning environment. Collaborative role-playing included specific roles that were related to a problem case about Internet copyright issues. Students were randomly assigned to a collaborative role-playing group and a collaborative learning group. Students in the collaborative role-playing group had more positive attitudes toward group-work and the solving of ill-structured problems. However, the collaborative role-playing group was not significantly different from the collaborative learning group requiring no such the role-playing in terms of two constructs of ill-structured problem solving: problem analysis and solution development.
